lines.trans: Hey, Vanya, get up, get up!
Come on, get up, you'll freeze in the snow!
Arise, vast country...
What country? Get on your feet!
A vast country...
You slept here all night!
Where am I? What time is it?
It's already morning, people are walking past.
Lyokha! Where is my friend Lyokha?
Your friend is sleeping at home.
Listen, do you need a tank?
Go and take it!

вставать.gloss: to get up, to stand up

meanings.note: out of bed or from the floor

examples.trans: Come on, Tuzik, let's get up!
I get up at seven in the morning.
The main thing is, you keep him at home.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: забирать деньги = to take the money
забирать детей из школы = to pick the kids up from school

examples.trans: I pick the children up from school.

meanings.en: to get cold, feel chilled; to freeze solid

examples.trans: Danya, are you cold or what?
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?
It's already morning, people are walking past.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: Russian uses one word for both
ночью = at night; спокойной ночи = good night
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

проспать.gloss: to sleep through, overslept; sleep for
